styleHint: Deliberately archaic high fantasy. Formal, weighty, occasionally Middle-English-flavoured ('mine own counsel doth suggest'). Keep that weight; do not modernise it into casual speech.
notes: The reference profile. This is the game the whole tool was designed and tested against, so it is the most complete example of what a profile should contain.
